After the people of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] held an anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] demonstration, the Empire retaliated by '''massacring''' three families who participated in the demonstration.

==Prelude==
Sometime before [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] several Sulonese [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]], complained about [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] policies and eventually publicly gathered in the city of [[Barons Hed]] for a nonviolent demonstration. [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] reacted but not before they scramled.

To avoid embarrassment, the local [[Commandant/Legends|commandant]] resolved to the recorded [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] (and the collaboration of a traitor) to identify and hunt them.<ref name="DF:RA" />

==The attack==
[[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] had the information from [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] that the colony had about four hundred Rebels and the [[Walker/Legends|walker]] operators sought to kill as many as possible; one walker on purpose targeted a dormitory, and twenty to thirty civilians escaped the rubble to declare their surrender, only to be targeted and shot by the walker's [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]].<ref name="RAaudio">[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]]</ref>

The attack [[Death/Legends|claimed the life]] of three families,<ref name="RAaudio" /> including [[Katie Grawley]].
{{Battle-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
There is some discrepancy about the timing of the massacre between the ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'' novel and the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|audio drama]]. The novel suggests that after the massacre, the Rebels agreed to listen to [[Morgan Katarn]] and left for [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].

In the audio drama, it is suggested that Morgan somehow expected the worst and persuaded the demonstrators to leave the planet as a precaution; most of the Rebels are already far from Sulon when the Empire attacked, if not for three families who preferred to stay, and lose their lives. The same day of the event Morgan reveals to the Rebels their secret destination, and after some scepticism and complaints, he informs them about what happened that morning, to their friends who didn't follow them.
